title: What could be in the Budget?
description: Chancellor John Healey will set out his plans for UK taxes on 28 October.

title: Watch: What happens now after close vote in Israeli election?
description: Polls have closed in the Israeli election, but there is no clear winner.

title: Confusion about Flávio Bolsonaro's whereabouts as Argentina says he flew to Ecuador
description: The defeated presidential candidate's whereabouts are unclear, as Argentina says he boarded a flight to Ecuador.

title: King acknowledges 'suffering of the past' as Caribbean tour begins
description: The King is on a nine-day tour that will take him to three countries, including the Bahamas, Guyana and Antigua and Barbuda.

title: Trump says US voter fraud is 'rampant' - evidence suggests it is extremely rare
description: As the US president casts doubt on the security of the midterm elections, BBC Verify examines his claims.

title: Landline switchover could cut people off in emergency, MPs warn
description: Plans to switch to digital landlines by January could leave remote areas of the UK vulnerable, MPs say.

title: Multiple sclerosis patient living in 'horrific pain' due to UK-wide drugs shortage
description: Jill Kenning says she has been unable to get a drug she uses to manage her condition.

title: 'Biggest night in club's history' as fearless Fleetwood stun Arsenal in EFL Cup
description: A whopping 83 league places separated Fleetwood from Arsenal, yet the hosts booked their place in the Carabao Cup quarter-final thanks to their penalty shootout win over the Gunners.

title: Luxury cruise passengers stranded in Cambodia due to soaring fuel costs
description: The Villa Vie Odyssey suspended its voyage and is working with passengers on "temporary living arrangements".
